trust_decision.summary: omarchy-theme-set decides whether a user theme dir came from a git clone (has .git, not a symlink) and, if so, refuses to stage *.lua, terminal configs, vscode.json and symlinks into the current theme. At the pinned commit this decision is ALREADY PRESENT: the advisory's fix commit ef6d9e66 is already in the tree.

landing_point.why: The summary names omarchy-theme-set and the files staged into ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme; this is the user-theme overlay copy, and at the pinned commit it already routes cloned themes through stage_installed_theme.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Hand-written user themes (no .git, or a symlink to a working copy) must still stage in full, including .lua and terminal configs; cloned themes keep colour files (btop.theme, helix.toml, backgrounds) and get colors.toml derived from alacritty.toml. Already implemented at pinned.

legacy alacritty.toml-only theme (palette extracted in scratch dir)
theme name with leading dot or slash

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the first-party overlay copies $OMARCHY_THEMES_PATH/$THEME_NAME with cp -r; a planted second staging function (e.g. a preview/switcher that stages a user theme with cp -r) would bypass the filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: omarchy-theme-switcher and omarchy-theme-dir also resolve user theme dirs (bin/omarchy-theme-switcher:12, bin/omarchy-theme-dir:14); a maintainer adding a live-preview staging path could copy the unfiltered cp -r line. This is a WHERE-type sibling only.

O9_family: CWE-829 untrusted code loading (third-party theme files executed by Hyprland/Neovim/terminals)
